input.quote: A. Customer acknowledges and agrees that the Monthly Base Fee pricing offered to Customer by M&I is based on certain services provided by M&I's Integrated Banking System. Customer agrees that, during the Term, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2.
input.rationale: Section 8.1(ii) imposes a "minimum monthly fee (\"Monthly Base Fee\")" and Section 10.3(A) requires us to source the entire bundle from M&I for the whole Term, which runs to the eighth anniversary of the Effective Date (p0049). There is no right for us to reduce volumes or drop Services, and the minimum feeds the Estimated Remaining Value used to compute the termination fees in Section 11.1/11.2, so the only exit is one year's notice plus a percentage of the remaining minimums — a penalty, not a true-up. By contrast, M&I may withdraw non-Core Services on 90 days' notice under 10.2. That is a multi-year take-or-pay commitment that fails the fallback (commitment limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, with a true-up). Eliminating the Monthly Base Fee entirely (preferred) would unwind the bundled pricing bargain, so we have proposed the fallback: the commitment runs only through the current twelve-month period and is reducible on 30 days' notice with an equitable true-up and no shortfall charge.

proposal.summary: Make the Monthly Base Fee minimum commitment reducible on 30 days' notice with an equitable true-up instead of an 8-year take-or-pay
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3(A) locks us into the full bundle of Monthly Base Fee Services for the entire eight-year Term with no ability to reduce volumes, while M&I may withdraw Services on 90 days' notice under 10.2. Our playbook does not accept multi-year take-or-pay, so we have limited the commitment to the current twelve-month period and allowed reduction on 30 days' notice with an equitable true-up of the Monthly Base Fee rather than a shortfall penalty.

ops.oldText: Customer agrees that, during the Term, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2.
ops.newText: Customer agrees that Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2, through the end of the then-current twelve (12) month period only. Customer may, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to M&I, discontinue or reduce any Service included in the Monthly Base Fee, in which case the parties shall equitably reduce the Monthly Base Fee to reflect the resource units no longer used by Customer. No shortfall, penalty or similar charge shall be payable by Customer in connection with any such discontinuation or reduction.
